scripts.circuits:ptau:new: [ -f build/pot18_0000.ptau ] && echo 'skip' || bunx snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 18 build/pot18_0000.ptau -v
scripts.circuits:ptau:contribute: [ -f build/pot18_0001.ptau ] && echo 'skip' || bunx snarkjs powersoftau beacon build/pot18_0000.ptau build/pot18_0001.ptau 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef 10

scripts.circuits:setup:contribute: bunx snarkjs zkey beacon build/withdraw/withdraw_0000.zkey build/withdraw/withdraw_final.zkey 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef 10

scripts.circuits:prove: bunx snarkjs groth16 prove build/withdraw/withdraw_final.zkey build/withdraw/witness.wtns build/withdraw/proof.json build/withdraw/public.json
scripts.circuits:verify: bunx snarkjs groth16 verify build/withdraw/verification_key.json build/withdraw/public.json build/withdraw/proof.json
